rationale: The agent verified the user correctly using name and zip, checked the correct account and order via tools, and accurately described the order status and item details. It appropriately declined a cross-category exchange and suggested a return after delivery, consistent with typical rules. However, the agent did not complete the user’s requested action (no exchange possible and no return initiated due to order status). More importantly, it promised to “remind” the user once delivered without using any tool to set such a reminder, which constitutes an unsupported/fabricated action. Therefore, it does not meet the pass bar of completing the request in line with policy and avoiding unsupported statements.
